name_en: Heshiko — mackerel salted and then aged for months in rice bran
summary_ja: 塩をしたサバをさらに半年ほど糠に漬けこむ、若狭・越前海岸の保存食。糠を落として炙ったり茶漬けや寿司ネタにするなど食べ方は幅広く、厳しい冬を越すたんぱく源だったと伝わる。
summary_en: Salted mackerel is packed in rice bran for around half a year along the Wakasa and Echizen coast. Once the bran is brushed off it can be grilled, flaked over rice, or used as sushi topping — said to have been a winter protein source in lean months.
source_title: へしこ 福井県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Hamana miso — a sweet-fermented paste of malted rice, beans, and pickled eggplant
summary_ja: 米麹でつくった甘酒に豆麹と醤油、塩漬けなすを混ぜて重石をし、20日ほど発酵させる福井の冬の保存食。徳川家康の好物「浜納豆」が越前に伝わり土地の気候に合わせて変化したものと伝わり、酒の肴にもよく合う。
summary_en: Sweet rice-malt amazake is mixed with bean koji, soy sauce, and salted eggplant, weighted down and left to ferment for about twenty days — a winter keeping food said to descend from 'hama-natto', a favorite of Tokugawa Ieyasu, adapted to Fukui's climate. It pairs well with sake.
source_title: はまなみそ 福井県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
